propositions: The field-readiness gate at session start waits for Epic Link and Epic Name fields that are provisioned only when the first Jira Software project is created, creating an ordering deadlock where the gate blocks the action that would satisfy it.
Experiment 30981084637 proved the root cause is action-ordering, not time budget: fields remained absent for 180s of silence but appeared within 0.05s of project creation.
The session-start field check must be relocated to after project provisioning in _assert_project_capabilities, the only point where those fields can exist.
The decision rule in not_ready_message blaming an empty customfield inventory on a short budget is incorrect and self-confirming; it must be rewritten to name the provisioning precondition.
All 62 DC harness cells errored at fixture setup in run 30975323866, but run 30982731669 after the fix shows 62 passed with 0 failed and 0 errored, confirming the ordering deadlock hypothesis.
